custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the connectivity of the metal keys to the wooden body. AI often fails to render the complex rod-and-lever systems of woodwinds correctly, resulting in fused or floating keys. Also, scrutinize the plaid background for non-Euclidean warping, which is a common tell-tale sign of generative models struggling with regular patterns.
